items.computation: Start day is the statement date, 3 November 2025 (a Monday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event is not counted, so counting starts 4 November 2025. Adding 30 days (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) lands on Wednesday, 3 December 2025. That day is a normal business day (not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Hamburg, where the landlord sits, or nationwide), so no § 193 BGB shift is needed. Final due date: 3 December 2025.
